cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James describes its value proposition to advisors as a 'best of both worlds' offer combining an advisor and client-focused culture with leading technology and solutions.
items.quote: our best of both worlds value proposition, where we offer a unique combination of an advisor and client-focused culture, coupled with leading technology and solutions, continues to resonate with advisors across all of our affiliation options

items.text: Raymond James states its value proposition is a unique combination of an advisor and client-focused culture coupled with leading technology and solutions, with a strong balance sheet and commitment to independence as a differentiator.
items.quote: We offer a unique combination of an advisor and client-focused culture, coupled with leading technology and solutions. This value proposition, coupled with our strong balance sheet and commitment to independence, is proving to be a differentiator for advisors evaluating alternatives.

items.text: Raymond James says advisers do not have to choose between culture and capabilities, offering an adviser and client-focused culture together with leading technologies, products and solutions, plus a strong balance sheet, long-term thinking and commitment to independence.
items.quote: At Raymond James, advisers do not have to choose between culture and capabilities. We offer a unique combination of an adviser and client-focused culture together with leading technologies, products and solutions advisers need to serve clients at a high level.

items.text: Raymond James describes its value proposition as 'powerfully personal,' focusing on personal relationships with financial advisors and giving them tools and resources to strengthen relationships with clients.
items.quote: The powerfully personal, the value proposition that we released with our annual report, several weeks ago, is increasingly differentiating as well... focusing on the personal relationships with financial advisors and giving them tools and resources to strengthen the personal relationships that they have with their clients.

items.text: Raymond James says it leads with culture and capabilities rather than the highest check, and considers this a differentiated value proposition.
items.quote: We don't lead with the highest check. We want to have competitive economics... but we lead with culture and capabilities. And so we have a true differentiated value proposition.

items.text: Raymond James states it attracts and retains advisors with its unique culture, leading service, and robust platform, whereas many competitors compete with the largest check.
items.quote: We attract and retain financial advisors with our unique culture, leading service, and robust platform, whereas many of our competitors compete with the largest check.

items.text: Raymond James says it has the largest total addressable market because it offers all affiliation options at scale (employee, independent contractor, RIA custody), so advisors do not have to wonder whether the firm offers a channel.
items.quote: We have the largest total addressable market based on having all of the affiliation options at scale, and when advisors are thinking about making a move, they don't have to select... they know that we offer it, they can really just understand whether or not we're a good fit for them culturally in terms of the capabilities that we offer.

items.text: Raymond James frames its independent contractor offering as 'a partnership in independence,' letting advisors run their own practice with access to the firm's full capabilities.
items.quote: A partnership in independence. Standing apart doesn't mean you need to stand alone. When you affiliate with Raymond James as an independent contractor, you can access our full capabilities at a level that's right for your business.

items.text: Raymond James says its independent contractor financial advisors are generally responsible for their own direct costs and receive a higher payout percentage than employee advisors, with options to build their business with as much or as little support as they need.
items.quote: Our financial advisors who are independent contractors are generally responsible for all of their direct costs and, accordingly, receive a higher payout percentage on the revenues they generate than employee financial advisors. Our independent contractor financial advisor options are designed to help our advisors build their businesses with as much or as little of our support as they determine they need.

items.text: Raymond James states its value proposition of the 'best of both worlds' provides a culture that is advisor and client-focused with capabilities, technologies, and solutions.
items.quote: our value proposition of the best of both worlds, where we provide culture that is advisor and client-focused with capabilities, technologies, and solutions.
